label: Finite controls for Darwinian epistemic debunking and its self-application
paraphrase: Five finite controls. Origin fixing with within-history variation gives a tracking failure while the actual verdict is accurate. One omission example: with variation but no origin fixing, every history-mate is accurate, so origin fixing is needed. History-fixed correctness with an accurate selection-fixed verdict has no tracking failure. In the existing targeted reliability control the realist self-application premises hold and the conclusion lacks warrant while true, with thin F6 holding as undefeated support for other content. A no-undercutting model with history-fixed correctness for every basis satisfies the uniform policy, sole-basis and warrant conditions and keeps the conclusion warranted; it fits constructivist, functional and necessitarian-realist readings alike.
